description: This file defines telemetry event handling for Next.js CLI sessions, including configuration detection and event payload construction.

methods.name: hasBabelConfig
methods.description: Checks if a given directory has a Babel configuration that is not for tooling purposes.

methods.name: getNextConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the Next.js configuration for a given phase and directory.

methods.name: eventCliSession
methods.description: Generates and returns telemetry event data for a Next.js CLI session based on current configuration and environment.
